claims.text: Timer displays elapsed time in minutes and seconds format (MM:SS)
claims.details: The invariant ensures currentTime is non-negative, which allows valid MM:SS display. ElapsedTimeNonNegative lemma explicitly proves m.currentTime >= 0.

claims.text: A single tap or keypress creates a lap marker at the current elapsed time
claims.details: The Apply function for CreateLap action creates a new Lap with timestamp = currentTime. StepPreservesInv ensures the result satisfies Inv.

claims.text: Each lap records the duration from the previous lap marker (or start) to the current marker
claims.details: CreateLap computes duration as currentTime - lastLapTime, where lastLapTime tracks the previous lap timestamp (or 0 for start). LapDurationsNonNegative ensures all durations are non-negative.

claims.text: Sessions are organized hierarchically: a Talk contains Sections, each Section contains one or more Takes
claims.details: The Model contains a seq<Lap> where each Lap has a section:string field. The hierarchy is represented by laps grouped by section labels.

claims.text: Each lap can be labeled with a section name after it is recorded
claims.details: LabelLap action updates lap[idx].section to the given name. StepPreservesInv ensures the model remains valid after labeling.

claims.text: All takes are preserved with their timestamps and durations
claims.details: LapsValid ensures all laps have valid timestamps and durations. StepPreservesInv proves this property is maintained across all actions.

claims.text: Users can manually select which takes to include in the final talk total
claims.details: SelectLapToggles lemma proves that selecting a lap toggles its selected boolean field.

claims.text: Users can delete unwanted or noisy takes (without affecting other takes' durations)
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.DeletePreservesDurations ensures: forall i | 0 <= i < idx :: Apply(m, DeleteLap(idx)).laps[i].duration == m.laps[i].duration
claims.details: DeletePreservesDurations lemma explicitly proves that deleting a lap preserves the durations of all other laps.

claims.text: Users can manually adjust the duration of any take
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.AdjustOnlyChangesDuration ensures: Apply(m, AdjustDuration(idx, dur)).laps[idx].duration == dur
claims.details: AdjustOnlyChangesDuration lemma proves the adjusted lap gets the new duration while preserving other properties.

claims.text: Total estimated talk duration is computed by summing the selected takes
claims.details: The Sum function computes total duration. SelectedTotalIsNonNegative proves the sum of non-negative durations is non-negative.

claims.text: Moving a lap up swaps it with the previous lap
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.MoveUpSwaps ensures: Apply(m, MoveUp(idx)).laps[idx-1] == m.laps[idx] && Apply(m, MoveUp(idx)).laps[idx] == m.laps[idx-1]
claims.details: MoveUpSwaps lemma proves the swap behavior for moving a lap up.

claims.text: Moving a lap down swaps it with the next lap
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.MoveDownSwaps ensures: Apply(m, MoveDown(idx)).laps[idx] == m.laps[idx+1] && Apply(m, MoveDown(idx)).laps[idx+1] == m.laps[idx]
claims.details: MoveDownSwaps lemma proves the swap behavior for moving a lap down.

claims.text: Moving preserves all lap data (duration, label, selection, expected)
claims.details: The swap lemmas prove laps are moved intact (the entire Lap record is swapped, preserving all fields). MovePreservesCount also confirms no laps are lost.

claims.text: Moving the first lap up has no effect
claims.details: MoveUpFirstNoEffect lemma proves that moving the first lap up returns the unchanged model.

claims.text: Moving the last lap down has no effect
claims.details: MoveDownLastNoEffect lemma proves that moving the last lap down returns the unchanged model.

claims.text: Starting practice captures section labels as a template queue
claims.details: SetTemplate action sets the template field to the provided seq<TemplateEntry>. StepPreservesInv ensures validity.

claims.text: Each lap in practice mode consumes one template entry
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateDecreasesQueue proves the template queue decreases by one after consumption.

claims.text: Consumed template entry sets the lap's section label
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateSetsLabel lemma proves the last lap gets its section from the first template entry.

claims.text: Consumed template entry sets the lap's expected duration
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateSetsExpected lemma proves the expected duration is set from the template entry.

claims.text: Template queue length decreases by one after consumption
claims.details: Directly proven by ConsumeTemplateDecreasesQueue lemma.

claims.text: Importing laps preserves existing laps
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.ImportPreservesExisting ensures: forall i | 0 <= i < |m.laps| :: Apply(m, ImportLaps(laps)).laps[i] == m.laps[i]
claims.details: ImportPreservesExisting lemma proves all existing laps are preserved at their original indices.

claims.text: Imported laps are appended to the end of the lap list
claims.details: ImportAppendsToEnd proves imported laps are appended (combined with ImportPreservesExisting, this confirms append behavior).

claims.text: Import is atomic (single undo removes all imported laps)
claims.details: ImportLaps is a single action in the domain. The Kernel's UndoRedoRoundTrip proves that undoing then redoing returns to original state, implying atomicity of actions.

claims.text: All lap, label, select, and delete actions support undo and redo operations
claims.details: The Kernel module proves undo/redo preserve history invariant. UndoRedoRoundTrip and RedoUndoRoundTrip prove round-trip behavior.

claims.text: The undo/redo stack preserves complete action history for the session
claims.obligation: AppCore.UndoRedoRoundTrip ensures: Redo(Undo(h)) == h + RedoUndoRoundTrip ensures: Undo(Redo(h)) == h
claims.details: These round-trip lemmas prove that undo/redo are inverses, preserving complete history. DoHasNoRedoBranch ensures new actions clear redo branch.
